Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY5P21C338ZZ91N2K2HJJ3YW on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: open. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T19:50:19.267887Z.

Conditional follow-up only; do not start until the oracle decomposition localizes a remaining failure.

If oracle initialization enters a <=4 mm residual basin but HalfFlow remains inaccurate, audit rank-one scaling as a global mean-CC scalar residual with per-voxel gradient factors and dimensionless median-gradient damping. Only then test dual-anchored symmetric refinement to isolate midpoint resampling blur.

Separately evaluate export on a true computational halo: extend background motion beyond the requested FoV, apply no image forces in the halo, integrate/invert on the padded grid, crop after validation, and report interior max, whole-field p99, and boundary max separately. This is not boundary tapering.

Acceptance: each conditional branch requires a predeclared trigger from B4, an analytic/differential oracle, matched runtime, JVM/Scala.js coverage, and a retain/reject receipt. Do not add velocity jets, semantic features, learned deformation, or GPU specialization here.
set.title: BasinBridge B5: conditional fine-model and export-halo falsification
